source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The tabmail stylesheet sets -moz-user-focus:ignore only in the selected-tab branch. The historical selector checks selected=true; the accepted selector later checks presence of selected. Keep this local focus override separate from switching tabs, header focus and blanket tab-focus suppression. The shared native focus behavior and keyboard/drag/accessibility outcomes were not executed here.
title: The tab focus override is scoped to the currently selected tab
